📋 Certificate Approvals
📋 Forms
Controlled form templates — F022 Master List of Forms · ISO/IEC 17025 8.3 · MD, QM and TM only
🧯 Risk Register (FMEA)
F032 FMEA worksheets and F031 register log · ISO/IEC 17025 4.1.4–4.1.5 (impartiality) and 8.5 (risks)
📚 Documents (F020)
ISO/IEC 17025 8.3 · LQP 8.3 — master list of internal and external documents, F014, controlled hard copies, obsolete documents
📊 Management Review
ISO/IEC 17025 8.9 · LQP 8.9 — F007 agenda with inputs from the LIMS, outputs and actions; F029 anonymous staff feedback
🔍 Internal Audits
ISO/IEC 17025 8.8 · LQP 8.8 — plan (F001), notice (F002), attendance (F003), checklist (F004), findings (F005), report (F006)
💡 Improvement Register
ISO/IEC 17025 8.6 · LQP 8.6 — suggestions, the MD's selection, actions and their effectiveness
🗓️ Meetings (F021)
LQP 8.2 7.3 — laboratory management meetings: minutes, action items
🎯 Quality Policy & Objectives
ISO/IEC 17025 8.2 · LQP 8.2 — policy acknowledgement and the yearly quality objectives
💻 LIMS & Data
ISO/IEC 17025 7.11 · LQP 7.11 — user manual, system failures, LIMS releases, calculation sheets, backup record
🧪 Validity of Results
ISO/IEC 17025 7.7 · LQP 7.7 — yearly monitoring plan, results, PT / ILC, review of reported results
📗 Working Instructions
Step-by-step instructions for the work you are authorised to do (F025) · opens as a controlled copy with your name
📘 Methods (CLQI)
ISO/IEC 17025 7.2 · LQP 7.2 — methods register, F011 verification, F014 revisions, yearly review
🏅 Accreditation & Scope
ISO/IEC 17025 5.3 · LQM Appendix I — what Westlab may report as accredited
🌡️ Environmental Records
ISO/IEC 17025 6.3 · LQP 6.3 — monthly lab logger records, out-of-limit calibrations and halts, yearly facility review, mapping, limits
🎓 Competence & Authorisation
ISO/IEC 17025 6.2 · LQP 6.2 — competence files, F018 training, F017 / F034 assessments, F025 matrix, yearly monitoring
📌 Notice Board
Quality and operations notices · posted by the MD, QM or TM · the MD approves before staff see them
🪪 Visitor Log
F026 · ISO/IEC 17025 4.2.4 — visitors agree to confidentiality and sign in and out
🔒 Confidential Information Release
F027 · ISO/IEC 17025 4.2 — release only with MD approval; the customer is told unless the law prohibits it
⚠️ Nonconformance, Complaints & CAPA
ISO/IEC 17025 7.9 complaints · 7.10 nonconforming work · 8.7 corrective action

🔤 Certificate Font
The font used on Certificate Page 1. Upload the font file (.ttf / .otf / .woff2) and every PC and phone prints the certificate with exactly that font — it doesn't need to be installed on each computer.
On Windows the font files are in C:\Windows\Fonts (right-click the font → Copy, then upload). Use a font your company is licensed to use.
